verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never documents choosing a storage region or data-residency location for Simular/Sai data. The BYOD option, which runs Sai on the user's own Mac or Windows device "with control and privacy", is an adjacent execution-environment choice, not region or residency selection for stored data, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)
